items.html: And the second cause, which is for the sake of the milk, will be explained, God willing, below. And the third cause, which is for the sake of the Mochin, will also be explained below. For the NHY of Ima must empty of her lights, so that after the birth, immediately, the Mochin of ZA will enter within them, and all of them will be clothed together within ZA, for ZA too has Mochin at the time of Yenika, as above. This is the secret that the Torah endures only in one who kills himself over it. For Tvuna is called Mi [who], and through this Mi, who kills herself, ZA endures, for his entire existence is only through the Mochin, as this is well explained below.
